purpose: Persist stable task context without accepting unresolved business proposals
stable_constraints: Reuse D identity and resource APIs; never access another module business tables or share ORM entities
Actor identity comes from server-validated CF_SESSION; reject client-forged identity
Require D authorization allowed=true; identity presence alone is insufficient
Keep service secrets server-side and out of logs
Do not substitute D public permissions for M3 business permissions
Do not bypass missing dependencies or present test doubles as completed real integration
Plan before implementation; explicit scope, constraints and acceptance criteria for every AI task
Human verification before commit; peer review; humans resolve merge conflicts
Use versioned migrations and idempotent seed scripts; no manual schema changes
Preserve unfinished requirements and distinguish proposed rules, implementation and verified evidence

dependency_snapshot.basis: local repository source inspection; recheck before integration
dependency_snapshot.M1: Maintenance block contract is a draft; outside current reporting/query/dispatch implementation scope

pending_human_decisions: D business permission registration and role mapping review
Shared ingress and M3 independent CSRF integration review
Dedicated database role provisioning and peer schema review

change_policy: Update this context when the user explicitly changes scope or rules; external contracts and schema changes still require affected-owner review. Do not infer acceptance from a recommendation.
